checkpoint.view: Directory of links to the provisioned shards, config, index and tokenizer.json, plus the pinned-revision tokenizer_config.json. The provisioned directory itself fails the pin on tokenizer_config.json only.

execution.host: One Linux x86-64 research host, CPU only, eight threads; checkpoint on an external drive
execution.mode: Clear client-local execution; no keys, ciphertexts or evaluator
execution.timingNote: Step and elapsed times include time paused for other work on the host; only the two cached floating steps listed ran without a pause.

coefficientInventory.retained: Not committed: one name and coefficient SHA-256 per projection, 9.4 MB. No coefficient cache was written.

limitations: One public five-token prompt and four greedy steps; not a quality or throughput result.
The floating reference is this graph itself over FP32-converted BF16 weights with the two declared source transforms; no second independent implementation was compared.
The twelve-bit pass was teacher-forced with the floating tokens. Largest logit difference grew to 1.24 by the fourth step.
Nothing here exercises encryption, an evaluator or the integrity mechanism.
